svg.title: M equals 9 lane to output element ownership inside one consumer warp
svg.desc: A sixteen by eight accumulator tile is labeled with the lane that owns each element. Lane four g plus p owns two adjacent columns in rows g and g plus eight.
svg.text: One consumer warp tile Dq[16,8] · lane = threadIdx.x mod 32 · every lane owns four FP32 accumulators
Explicit lane map for all 16×8 accumulator elements
Columns are local to consumer q; global n = blockIdx.x·BN + 8q + local n.
For M=9, d0 and d1 are always stored. d2 and d3 are stored only when g=0, which corresponds to logical row 8.
M=9 epilogue: Dq[1,2] and Dq[1,3] are stored; Dq[9,2] and Dq[9,3] are discarded.
